image_description: A white electric steam iron standing upright on its heel rest on a reflective surface. The iron features a translucent teal water tank, a molded white plastic body with an ergonomic handle, and a metallic soleplate with visible steam holes. A coiled power cord lies in the foreground to the right.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The side profile clearly shows the characteristic teardrop shape tapering to a point at the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Overall length is hand-spanning, sized for comfortable single-hand operation.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No reference object (like a hand) is present to verify scale, though proportions look standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ergonomic handle on top of molded body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handle structure is clearly visible, connecting the front and rear of the upper body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Temperature control dial and steam function buttons on the body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While there are markings under the handle, specific distinct dials or tactile buttons are not clearly resolved; they appear as printed graphics or vague molds rather than functional components.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Dark spots indicating steam vents are visible along the edge of the soleplate near the tip.

The white housing has the smooth, continuous curves typical of injection-molded plastic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Home appliance for smoothing fabric wrinkles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is unmistakably identifiable as a clothes iron.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The front part of the handle appears to merge into the main body without a clear gap or structural support logic, looking slightly 'melted' or fused rather than mechanically attached.
The teal water tank lacks internal depth or fluid definition; it looks like a solid colored plastic insert rather than a transparent container holding water.
The coils of the cord have inconsistent thickness and some loops seem to pass through each other or lack clear spatial separation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of iron and rule out misclassification as similar appliances.
To verify if the handle is a separate topological entity or if it suffers from fusion artifacts with the main body.
To check if the cord loops have valid 3D structure and if the soleplate sits correctly on the surface.
To assess overall rendering quality, lighting consistency, and subtle texture issues.

focus_areas: Transparency and depth of the water tank
Spatial coherence of the power cord loops
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle-body junction. In AI images, handles often fuse into the body. Check if the 'buttons' are just painted on textures rather than physical protrusions. Verify if the cord defies physics by intersecting itself.
